title: placement_confirmation
description: The facts the message kind placement_confirmation (you are scheduled: details and a calendar file) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product from the raw facts and the record data, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Placement confirmation (you are scheduled)
triggers: A student is placed with status assigned or confirmed in a class that is scheduled or enrolling, has a venue and a start time, and the person has an email address (automatic).
An operator presses Send confirmation email on a student row (manual).

name.description: How the email greets the person: their given name, else their display name, else the word there.

start_utc.description: When the class starts (UTC, to the second). Used for the calendar file.

end_utc.description: When the class ends (UTC). Start plus the duration, 60 minutes if none is set. Used for the calendar file.

time_zone.description: The class's time zone as an IANA name; America/Denver if none is set. An unknown name shows times in UTC.

when_day.description: The day in words, in the class's time zone.

when_span.description: The start and end times with the zone abbreviation, in the class's time zone.

when_short.description: A short day and start time for subject lines.

venue.description: The venue's name. Absent when none.

room.description: The room label at the venue. Absent when none.

where.description: Venue and room together, joined with a middle dot. Absent when both are absent.
examples: Ozo's Coffee, East Pearl · Back room

address.description: The venue's address on one line. Absent when none.

map_url.description: A map search link for the venue and address. Absent when there is neither.

notes.description: The class's venue notes (parking, doors). Absent when none.

lead.description: The lead instructor's display name. Absent when none is placed.

also_teaching.description: The other instructors' display names, joined with commas. Absent when none.

confirmation_number.description: The confirmation number of the placement. Absent when none.

uid.description: The id the calendar file uses to recognize this event, so a later update replaces it. The attendance record's id.
